content.text:
Live and reloaded lookup now agree in boundary and randomized tests, including all prefix lengths, 8,192 distinct prefixes, colliding front keys, and maximum put/query counts. Independently constructed images also passed with arbitrary stages, odd-cell half nodes, reordered NI segments, and TYPE3 direct children.

`python3 public_check.py` was attempted, but its supervisor failed with `Operation not permitted`. I ran all seven published fixtures directly through `run.py`; they passed.

arguments.command: find src -type f -printf '%p %s\n'; command -v g++ || true; ls -l /usr/bin/g++* 2>/dev/null || true; du -sh src; sed -n '1,140p' src/scamptrie_dynamic.h; cat src/image.hpp
